item.title: I Fine-Tuned an LLM.
item.guid: title:i fine tuned an llm
item.description: AI is all the hype now, whether you’re a software engineer using it for your projects, or a student trying to write your 2000-word essay; AI is all around us. A simple search on Google sends you back a summary of all the search results, helping you with the answer at a glance. Copilot rewrites all your mails on Outlook for you. If (and you must have) you have spent any time at all with LLMs now, you would notice how well they cope with human language. Most often, with simple queries and common subjects, LLMs answer very well. The LLMs we are communicating with and evaluating the performance of, as of 8th November, 2026, are very advanced, like Claude Opus 5, or GPT 6 Astra.

item.title: Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence
item.guid: title:kimi k3 open frontier intelligence
item.description: Today, we are introducing Kimi K3 — our most capable model. Kimi K3 is a 2. 8T-parameter model built on our Kimi Delta Attention and Attention Residuals, with native vision capabilities and a 1-million-token context window. It is the world's first open 3T-class model, designed for frontier intelligence across long-horizon coding, knowledge work, and reasoning. While its overall performance still trails the most powerful proprietary models, Claude Fable 5 and GPT 5. 6 Sol, Kimi K3 demonstrated frontier-level performance across our evaluation suite, consistently outperforming other tested models.
